_: A copy of this file named config.json is the only place personal values live. Everything else in the repository is impersonal.
_windowsRoot: Where models, llama.cpp, logs and launch scripts go on Windows. Needs ~40 GB free (model + build).
_wslDistro: Name of the WSL2 distribution. The installer creates it if missing.
_lang: Language of the installer and launcher messages: "en" or "ru". Translations live in i18n/<lang>.json; anything missing there stays English.
_harnessTag: Empty = take the tag from stand.lock.json (the verified combination). Set it only to install a different version on purpose.
_ports: webPort is the DSH interface; modelPort is llama-server. The model port listens on 0.0.0.0 so WSL can reach Windows.

tunnel._: Phone access through a Cloudflare tunnel. An empty domain means no tunnel is configured and the stand stays on the local network.

model._: What to download. windows/20-model.ps1 picks this for your GPU; the value here is what the repository is tuned for (RTX 5080, 16 GB).

server._: llama-server settings. windows/30-tune.ps1 recomputes ctx for your VRAM and verifies it by measurement.

features._: Which plugins to install. Patch layers apply only to the enabled ones.
